description: Super-human healthcare. The operating system for specialist healthcare.
about: 01Health is building a platform focused on up-skilling and training health professionals. They are starting in dental care and their longer term vision covers the broader health system.
impact: 01Health's training platform increases clinical confidence leading to higher quality provision of health care services, initially in dentistry.

about: Airhive are building direct air capture (DAC) technology which leverages fluidisation to deliver fast, scalable and affordable CO2 removal.
impact: To limit global warming to 1.5C, planet earth needs to halve CO2 emissions by 2030, get to net zero by 2050 and then be removing 10GtCO2 annually thereafter towards 2100. Therefore, while reductions are critical, carbon removal technologies also need to be scaled in tandem.

about: Axle is building the infrastructure layer that will control, aggregate and optimise a consumer’s energy assets (EVs, heat pumps, etc.), allowing them to use energy when it’s cheapest and cleanest whilst also monetising these assets through providing flexibility services to the grid.
impact: Axle's product will ultimately reduce the consumer’s energy bill and carbon footprint whilst increasing the capacity of the grid to transition towards a renewable energy future.

about: Byway is developing an AI powered booking engine for multi-modal, experience based and flight free travel.
impact: Tourism is responsible for 8-11% of global greenhouse gas emissions and 17% of this is aviation related. Byway provides a platform for customers to book experience based travel itineraries free from flights.

description: Making consumer law more accessible and affordable.
about: Conveyd is building an AI powered legal tech firm focused initially on conveyancing with a broader vision to make consumer law fast, affordable, accessible and accurate.
impact: Conveyd is improving access to quality legal services for consumers, starting with conveyancing.

about: Cyclana Bio is focused on identifying the causes and cure for Endometriosis using menstrual fluid analysis.
impact: 1 in 10 women of reproductive age suffer with endometriosis. Cyclana Bio are building a data platform to better research, diagnose, and develop therapeutics for Endometriosis.

founders: Adam Kugler, Alice van der Schoot
about: Ditto Daily is focused on developing science backed supplements which improve the everyday lives of women. The first product is a supplement focused on improving symptoms linked to the menstrual cycle.
impact: 80% of women experience period pain at some stage in their life and in 40% of women the pain is accompanied by premenstrual symptoms. Ditto is creating solutions to support women who experience menstrual health related pain.

about: Flok Health provides a digital physiotherapy solution that customises individual treatment pathways using AI.
impact: By providing a one-to-many physiotherapy solution, Flok ensures that patients can get immediate access to effective treatment. Delivering treatment remotely also aims to promote adherence and improve outcomes.

about: Foresight Data Machines is building a platform to optimise the manufacturing process in EAF steel plants.
impact: The application of AI to EAF steel manufacturing has the potential to significantly reduce energy usage and hence the carbon emissions associated with steel. Furthermore, by improving the economics of EAF plants, it accelerates their uptake and the future of circular steel.

about: Hesta Health’s vision is to improve the healthcare system for women. Their initial focus is providing a comprehensive postnatal healthcare program.
impact: Whole-person and tech-enabled pathway addressing mothers’ health needs from pregnancy to 24 months post birth.

about: Hived is a parcel delivery company that is using a combination of software, data science and model innovation to build a zero-emission, low cost but high-quality service. ‍ The result is a parcel delivery service that works better for businesses, customers and for the environment.
impact: Hived are re-designing parcel delivery from the ground up to reduce air and noise pollution within cities.

description: Producing the world's cleanest, highest performing running shoes.
about: Hylo combines product design, material science and model innovation to create more sustainable sportswear items. Their first product is a running trainer which has a carbon footprint of 6.56kgCO2e, which is 51% less than the industry standard.
impact: By setting the standard for what is possible and combining that with their influencer led education, Hylo has an opportunity to change the behaviours of the sportswear and fashion market as a whole to be more sustainable.

description: Digital care pathways to transform healthcare.
about: Isla is a software platform for hospitals that enables doctors to design care pathways for remote patient monitoring.
impact: By enabling clinicians to treat more patients & make better, earlier decisions outside of clinical settings the platform can improve health outcomes, quality of life through treatment and reduce cost to care.

description: Preventative care for bladder and pelvic health.
about: Jude is focussed on providing consumers with products and services that help individuals manage healthcare issues that become more common as you age and are often taboo topics. They're starting with bladder care products.
impact: Improving the quality of life for people suffering from age-related conditions, while also breaking down the stigma associated with these conditions.

description: Navigation technology for the visually impaired.
about: MakeSense is combining haptic technology, RTK GPS and AI to provide better navigation technology for the visually impaired.
impact: There are 170k blind people in the UK but only 4k guide dogs available due to their high cost of training of over £50k per guide dog. MakeSense is creating the first cost effective technology solution that can replace and improve upon the guide dog, increasing access to mobility for blind people globally.

description: Making personalised education available to all.
about: Medly AI is building a platform accessible across multiple device types that is highly effective at providing personalised tuition to students in an engaging manner.
impact: Medly AI is improving educational outcomes and reducing inequality through affordable AI-powered personalised tuition.

description: Transforming the footprint of mineral exploration.
about: MINML is a software company that uses an AI model to more accurately predict the location of critical minerals. Reducing the footprint of extraction and helping to secure the supply chain needed for the green transition.
impact: Critical minerals are essential inputs for low carbon technologies but the supply chain is fragile and discovering and extracting these critical minerals comes with significant environmental and social risk. This problem is one of the top barriers to transition to renewable energy over the next 20 years. Minml are building technology to reduce the need for broad, low confidence drilling campaigns and better incorporate environmental and social risks into the decision making process.

about: Oxford Cancer Analytics combines advances in machine learning and proteomics with liquid biopsy to provide earlier detection of cancer with high accuracy and affordability.
impact: The earlier cancer is detected, the greater the probability of survival through curative treatment. Their test is designed to be scalable and affordable, with an initial focus on lung cancer.

about: Paired helps couples improve their relationships through a daily interaction focused on healthy communication.
impact: Paired is a stigma free way of improving relationships. Relationship quality has been proven to be correlated with better physical and mental health and childhood development.

description: Bringing structure to the way people exercise.
about: Runna is a digital running coaching app that's designed to both help people get into running and then take their fitness to the next level.
impact: Habitual runners are estimated to add 3 years to their life and see a 27% reduction in all-cause mortality rates. Getting people into running, making the activity more enjoyable and increasing the runner's ability is core to Runna's mission.

description: Enabling creators to turn ideas into complete brand identities.
about: Sourceful's platform enables clients to find, customise and design sustainable packaging and offset their carbon footprint. Clients can use real-time data to understand the impact of every choice and make informed decisions about their business.
impact: Sourceful is developing the tools, data and products needed to make supply chains more sustainable.

about: Sustained helps food and beverage companies measure and reduce their environmental footprint at scale.
impact: By automating product life cycle analysis, Sustained helps clients develop better strategy to reduce the impact of their product portfolio.

about: Urban Jungle has developed proprietary insurance products to make them accessible and fair. ‍ Their initial product is a monthly contents insurance product focused on the renters market which has traditionally been underserved.
impact: Urban Jungle uses data to target and profitably underwrite customer segments that have traditionally been excluded from accessing insurance.

about: XRlabs is combining the latest developments in computer vision, AI and mixed reality hardware to revolutionise surgical planning and navigation.
impact: XRlabs will present the patient's 3D anatomy in a visual handsfree format to the surgeon, resulting in improved patient outcomes.
